Paper: Wang et al. (2010) — ciprofloxacin on Ca-montmorillonite SAz-1
Critical caveat for synthesis: Reported 330 mg/g maximum capacity and ~292 mg/g observed loading use very high initial CIP concentrations (500–4,000 mg/L).
